items.title: Simulate remote CI failure via ralph-smoke step while creating seed note
items.description:
Goal: exercise Ralph repair loop with a harmless, workflow-only CI failure.

Work primarily under `sandbox/ralph-ci-failures/`. Create `sandbox/ralph-ci-failures/README.txt` with a short note describing this CI-failure simulation series.

Remote-CI failure simulation requirement (intentional, first PR attempt only):
- Add a temporary failing step to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` in job `ralph-smoke` that runs only for pull requests where `github.head_ref == 'ralph/task-301'`.
- The step should fail fast (for example, print a message and `exit 1`).
- Do NOT break YAML syntax.
- On Ralph repair attempt, remove the temporary failing step and keep the sandbox file change.

Safety constraints:
- Final merged diff must not contain any CI-failure simulation step.
- Final merged diff should only contain the intended sandbox file change(s).

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-ci-failures/README.txt` exists and has at least 2 lines.
- Ralph repair loop is exercised at least once due to remote CI failure.
- Final PR checks are green.

items.title: Simulate Linux matrix CI failure while creating alpha marker
items.description:
Create `sandbox/ralph-ci-failures/alpha.txt` with exactly 3 short ASCII lines.

Remote-CI failure simulation requirement (intentional, first PR attempt only):
- Add a temporary failing step to job `ci` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that runs only when both conditions are true:
  - `github.event_name == 'pull_request'`
  - `github.head_ref == 'ralph/task-302'`
  - `runner.os == 'Linux'`
- The step should fail quickly and clearly.
- On Ralph repair attempt, remove the temporary failing step and keep the sandbox file change.

Safety constraints:
- Keep workflow syntax valid at all times.
- Final diff should not contain the temporary failing step.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-ci-failures/alpha.txt` exists and has 3 lines.
- First PR attempt fails remote CI (Linux matrix path).
- Final PR checks are green.

items.title: Simulate Windows matrix CI failure while creating beta marker
items.description:

Remote-CI failure simulation requirement (intentional, first PR attempt only):

- Fail fast and print a clear message.
- On Ralph repair attempt, remove the temporary failing step and keep the sandbox file change.

Acceptance criteria:

- Final PR checks are green.

items.title: Append an update line to alpha and trigger temporary ralph-smoke failure
items.description:
Append one new line to `sandbox/ralph-ci-failures/alpha.txt` that starts with `updated:`.

Dependencies ensure `alpha.txt` already exists.

Remote-CI failure simulation requirement (intentional, first PR attempt only):
- Add a temporary failing step to `ralph-smoke` scoped to PR branch `ralph/task-304`.
- Remove it during Ralph repair while preserving the alpha append change.

Acceptance criteria:
- `alpha.txt` gains one appended line beginning with `updated:`.
- Ralph repair loop is exercised due to remote CI failure.
- Final PR checks are green.

items.title: Create gamma summary from alpha and beta with temporary dual-matrix CI failure
items.description:
Create `sandbox/ralph-ci-failures/gamma.txt` summarizing `alpha.txt` and `beta.txt` (for example: filenames and line counts). Use a deterministic plain-text format.

Remote-CI failure simulation requirement (intentional, first PR attempt only):
- Add one temporary failing step to job `ci` scoped to PR branch `ralph/task-305` without OS filter, so both matrix jobs fail quickly.
- Remove it during Ralph repair attempt.

Acceptance criteria:
- `gamma.txt` exists and mentions both `alpha.txt` and `beta.txt`.
- First PR attempt fails remote CI on both matrix jobs.
- Final PR checks are green.

items.title: Create docs note with temporary Playwright-step-targeted CI failure
items.description:
Create `sandbox/ralph-ci-failures/docs/note-306.txt` with a short message.

Remote-CI failure simulation requirement (intentional, first PR attempt only):
- Add a temporary failing step in job `ci` immediately before `Run Playwright E2E`, scoped to PR branch `ralph/task-306`.
- Keep it fast and explicit (`echo` + fail).
- Remove it during Ralph repair attempt.

Safety constraints:
- Do not change secrets/env values in CI.
- Do not alter existing test commands beyond adding/removing the temporary step.

Acceptance criteria:
- `sandbox/ralph-ci-failures/docs/note-306.txt` exists.
- First PR attempt fails remotely near the E2E stage due to the temporary step.
- Final PR checks are green.
